hints: On the $y$-axis, set $x = 0$ in the circle equation.
walkthrough:
Every point on the y-axis has x=0.
Set $x = 0$ in the circle equation to find where it crosses the $y$-axis:
$$0^2 + y^2 - 8(0) - 2y - 15 = 0$$
$$y^2 - 2y - 15 = 0$$

Factorise and solve for the $y$-coordinates:
$$(y - 5)(y + 3) = 0 \implies y = 5 \quad \text{or} \quad y = -3$$
$$\text{Intersection points: } (0, 5) \quad \text{and} \quad (0, -3)$$
